name: Noob Archer vs Stickman Zombie 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Noob Archer vs Stickman Zombie is a hilarious archery game that puts you in the shoes of Noob, who must take down all those dancing Stickmen Zombies. Noob's just chilling at home and trying to get some nap when the Stickmen start causing a ruckus by playing some loud music and dancing around.
